Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification ("white-out") of the left hemithorax with ipsilateral mediastinal shift (trachea and heart displaced to the left), which is characteristic of a massive pleural effusion causing underlying lung collapse/atelectasis. A pneumothorax would appear radiolucent, and simple consolidation typically does not cause such significant volume loss and shift.
